params.ohlcv_rule: open = previous close (own c at i=0), high = c*1.001, low = c*0.999, volume = 1000 + (i%13)*10, tbv null

notes: bar times are t0_ms + grid_index*step_ms. Output is btcLeadLagZ per own-series bar (already shifted one bar). close is the full input; with ohlcv_rule the candles are reproducible. BTC marketCandles are the BTCUSDT series below.

cases.output_shift: output at grid g is the z of raw at g-1 (shiftForwardOneBar); the raw index r below is the unshifted one
cases.window_starts_inside_mask: raw rows 199+30 .. 199+718: the 720-row window still covers raw-NaN rows < W=199, count grows from 30 (outputs at 199+31 ..)
cases.window_edge: raw row 199+719 (output at 199+720): window [199, 199+719] starts exactly at W, leaving row 199-1 is NaN, nothing leaves. Raw row 199+720 (output 199+721): the first finite row (199) leaves
cases.window_after_mask: raw rows 199+721 .. end (N=999): window holds only finite rows
cases.flat_stretch_epsilon: grid 198..243: BTC flat. ALTAUSDT flat too (raw exactly 0, zero variance). ALTBUSDT grows x1.001 per bar (raw constant to rounding noise, epsilon rule). z null for outputs with count>=30 inside the stretch (outputs 199+30 .. 244); first finite output at grid 245 for both alts
cases.btc_gap: BTC bar at grid 299 absent: alts have NaN raw there, and at grid 300 BTC return spans two bars
cases.alt_own_gap_A: ALTAUSDT bar at grid 499 absent: array-adjacent return at grid 500 spans two bars (position 499), windows count rows
cases.alt_own_gap_B: ALTBUSDT bar at grid 699 absent (position of next bar 699)
cases.btc_symbol_all_nan: BTCUSDT call (marketCandles = its own candles) is all NaN
cases.market_null_all_nan: ALTAUSDT with marketCandles null is all NaN (checked, not stored)
